english.title: Permit use goods vehicle max gross weight of 3500kgs - tyre with less than 1.6mm depth of tread

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Road Vehicle Construction and Use Regulations 1986

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a goods vehicle with a maximum gross weight not exceeding 3500 kg , when the grooves of the tread pattern of a tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL LOCATION..) wheel of the vehicle were not of a depth of at least 1.6 mm throughout a continuous band comprising the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 27(4) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 41A of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
permit use on a road of a goods vehicle with a maximum gross weight not exceeding 3500 kg
when the grooves of the tread pattern of a tyre fitted to the wheel of the vehicle
was not of a depth of at least 1.6mm.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) For vehicles which require a minimum tread depth of 1mm (i.e. larger goods and passenger vehicles) see charge headings: H154, H158 and H160.
(ii) See also offence wordings: H422 and H423.
(iii) See also H149, H150 and H151 in relation to a passenger vehicles.
(iv) See also H425, H426 and H427 in relation to light trailers.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was a goods vehicle with a maximum gross weight not exceeding 3500 kg on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..). The grooves in the tread pattern of the tyre fitted to the **(..SPECIFY WHEEL..) wheel of the vehicle were less than 1.6 mm deep throughout a continuous band situated in the central three-quarters of the breadth of tread and round the entire outer circumference of the tyre.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three penalty points.

Discretionary disqualification.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
